  "question": "For Aegis Clinic, what do the latest records show about patch exposure? Please resolve this specific point: September internet-facing hosts still exposed to the specified critical flaw and the change from August on the same asset set.",
  "gap": "September internet-facing hosts still exposed to the specified critical flaw and the change from August on the same asset set.",
  "passages": [
    "I treated the announcement as a starting point and followed the measurement boundary through the reporting period.

Aegis's authenticated scanner ledger finds 18 exposed hosts in August and 5 in September across the same 120-host set, a reduction of 13 hosts.

Background to the observation: Aegis rolled out an endpoint management service.

The figures belong to the stated population and reporting dates. Extending them to another operator would require a separate observation. A count of installations and a count of successful outcomes use different denominators.

SYNTHETIC benchmark article. People, records and quantities in this standalone research fixture are invented."
  ]
}
